headline: Signals kit vendored, crawlers and automation no longer count as visitors, and deploy now fails if the bundle has no analytics config. No change to pages, feast days or Pozvat.

shipped.title: Signals kit: contract test, allow-list, bot-aware client, analytics guard

signals_fixed: signals contract test: src/platform/flywheel-events.contract.test.ts (vendored from autoskola-kviz main, glob unchanged: web source is /src). All app events (page_view, key_action, conversion, error, feedback_given) are on the allow-list.
vendored allow-list copy: src/platform/flywheel-events.json (version 2, 2026-10-27). App sends none of the pending names.

flywheel-client at reference: isAutomatedBrowser + isAutomated config. analytics.ts passes isAutomated = isLikelyBot (lib/telemetry.ts), which now also covers the reference's prerender/googleother/embedly/preview tokens.

CI analytics bundle guard: `node scripts/check-analytics.mjs dist # flywheel:analytics-guard` right before upload-pages-artifact, main push/dispatch only. Verified locally: fails on a build without Supabase env, passes with it.
CI concurrency: group ci-${{ github.ref }}, cancel-in-progress only when ref != refs/heads/main.

static pages: the /dusicky/* pages (hub + 176 towns) already had a first-party beacon; it now sends props {path, static: true, route, feast, ref, platform} and skips webdriver/bot UAs. City (/mesto/) and church (/kostel/) pages boot the app bundle and send page_view through the client, so no beacon was added there.

decisions.question: Where does the analytics guard run? The brief says the deploy job, but here dist is uploaded in the test job and the deploy job only publishes the artifact.
options: move the upload into the deploy job and guard there
decisions.default_taken: test job, right before upload-pages-artifact, same if-condition as the upload
decisions.why: Same exact dist, nothing rebuilds between the guard and the upload, and no change to the deploy pipeline days before Dušičky.

decisions.question: Use the client's default isAutomatedBrowser or the app's own isLikelyBot?
options: isLikelyBot extended with the reference tokens
decisions.default_taken: isLikelyBot extended with the reference tokens
decisions.why: The reference regex's bare bot\b flags CUBOT phones (real users, covered by an existing test). The extended isLikelyBot catches everything the reference catches otherwise.

decisions.question: Take the reference client's 'anon' fallback id when storage is unavailable?
decisions.why: A shared 'anon' merges every storage-less visitor into one visitor.

decisions.question: Touch the Dušičky beacon although Dušičky pages are off-limits in this pass?
decisions.why: The work package asks for exactly this on static pages; page markup and content are unchanged. Revert = one function in src/domain/feast.ts.

decisions.question: Dispatch a TestFlight build (AGENTS.md: every user-facing change goes to TestFlight)?
decisions.why: Not user-facing: nothing a person sees changed. Build 1.4 (85) stays current.

ios_events: The iOS (and Android) app is the same web bundle in a Capacitor shell, built with VITE_SUPABASE_URL / VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY in release-ios.yml / release-android.yml, so it sends the same events through flywheel-client with props.platform='ios'/'android' on page_view. WKWebView does not set navigator.webdriver, so real iOS users still count. iOS code untouched. It picks up the bot filter with the next store build.
next: Add the analytics guard to release-ios.yml and release-android.yml (a native build without the Supabase secrets ships an app that sends nothing). Not done here: iOS left alone in this pass.
The beacon's bot regex is a hand copy of isLikelyBot; a test that ties the two would keep them in sync.
'preview' in the bot regex is broad (from the reference); watch for real UAs containing it.
Upstream: the reference flywheel-client's bare bot\b flags CUBOT phones; consider (?:^|[^u])bot\b in the hub copy.
After 1–2 Nov: compare page_view with props.static=true against /dusicky/ sessions to see what Dušičky traffic did.
